title: legionctl op ID [--wait SECONDS]
description: One operation record, read back. This is how a client that lost its link finds out what happened; it never mutates anything. `--wait` long-polls until the record is finished or the deadline passes, and a deadline that passes is not a failure.

allOf.description: An id with no record on this machine is not an error about the machine; it is a `not-configured` answer with a null record, so a client can tell "never arrived" from "arrived and failed".

id.description: The id that was asked for, echoed. Additive: the canonical place to read the record is `op`.

waited.description: Set when --wait was given: how long this call actually waited, and whether it came back because the operation finished or because the deadline did.
